Topline: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics for mobile apps) evaluating embeddings + semantic search to replace current keyword search and approximate matching. Team wants to start on Hosted API for speed, then move to Dedicated once we validate throughput and cost profile.

Requirements summary (from 2026-02-18 call):
- Workloads: nightly batch backfill of 20M records (embeddings), near-real-time ingestion (1-2k vectors/min), query traffic ~300 qps peak across multitenant customers.
- Latency targets: 95th <= 120ms for single-vector nearest neighbor on production; tail latency important for UI snappiness.
- Throughput: need sustained throughput for bulk upserts (20M vectors over 12-18 hours) and burst query capacity during morning spikes.
- Vector DB: primary preference is managed vector DB (Pinecone) for time-to-market; also testing Milvus self-hosted on k8s for Dedicated path. Connector stability and bulk upsert idempotency are high priority.
- Integration pattern: embeddings produced in batch jobs (Spark) -> write to vector DB via connector; low-latency queries served via Redwood-hosted API with caching.
- Model: prefer open LLM embeddings; testing Redwood-verified L2/32-bit embeddings and quantized alternatives for cost.
- Security: SSO (SAML), org-level audit logs, KMS for key separation, and EU data residency for EU customers. Must pass basic SOC2 checklist before procurement.
